newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian iron ore exports to grow - ABARE.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian iron ore exports to grow - ABARE.

text.p: Australian iron ore exports are forecast to rise almost four million tonnes to 139 million tonnes in 1997/98, the government's key commodity forecaster said on Tuesday.
The Australian Bureau of Agricultural Resource Economics (ABARE) estimated Australian iron ore production at 148.5 million tonnes in 1996/97 and 152.0 million tonnes in 1997/98 in its March bulletin.
The 1996/97 estimate is below the 151.0 million tonnes forecast in the December bulletin, due to the availability of supply from stocks accumulated in 1996, ABARE said.
Iron ore export earnings are forecast to rise A$205 million in 1996/97 to A$3.1 billion and to exceed A$3.2 billion in 1997/98.
"The smaller rise forecast for 1997/98 is a reflection of the modest increases in forecast export volumes and negotiated contract prices," ABARE said.
Australian steel exports were forecast to rise to about 3.4 million tonnes in 1997/98, at a value of A$1.6 billion, reflecting higher prices and increased shipments to Asia.
